head_commit.message:
fix(tui_app_server): restore remote subagent hotkey switching

Backfill loaded remote subagent threads into the `tui_app_server`
navigation state so resumed and forked sessions recover agent-switch
context instead of leaving `Opt+Left/Right` with no adjacent target.

Also re-scan loaded subagent threads on the hotkey path before giving
up, which makes fast switching resilient when app-server thread
notifications arrive late or do not populate the cache eagerly.

workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: fix(tui): restore clean agent thread replay and streaming

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): stabilize streamed agent thread switching

Fix the remaining streamed agent rendering glitches when users switch
between agents mid-turn. The TUI now drains stale receiver backlog
before replay, preserves in-progress item-scoped content across
thread reattachment, and clips active cells by logical line groups so
transient redraws do not duplicate or truncate streamed paragraphs.

Mirror the render-path fixes in `tui_app_server` and keep the new
regressions and snapshot updates that lock down the thread replay,
streaming, and tall-cell rendering behavior.
